title: Dark Chocolate Fudge Sauce
summary: Thick, glossy dark chocolate fudge sauce built on cocoa and dark chocolate, ready in 15 min and perfect warm over ice cream.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: check the label; many contain soya lecithin or traces of milk

steps.title: Dissolve the sugar
steps.text: Put the sugar, milk and salt in the saucepan over medium-low heat and whisk gently for 5-6 min, until the grains have disappeared and tiny bubbles appear around the edge.

steps.title: Whisk in the cocoa
steps.text: Turn the heat down low and add the sifted cocoa, whisking until there are no dry pockets. Sifting first stops stubborn lumps forming.

steps.title: Melt the chocolate
steps.text: Lift the pan off the heat, drop in the chopped chocolate and let it sit for 3 min, then whisk until completely smooth.

steps.title: Finish with butter
steps.text: Add the cold butter a few cubes at a time, whisking until each addition disappears; the sauce turns glossy and thickens slightly. Whisk in the vanilla and serve warm.

tips: A common mistake is letting the sauce boil after the chocolate goes in, which can make it grainy; keep it off the heat from that point.
Cold butter whisked in at the end gives a thicker, shinier sauce than melted butter.
Reheat gently in short bursts, stirring often; the sauce only needs to be warm, not hot.
Pour over vanilla ice cream, poached pears or pancakes.
storage: Cool, then keep in a covered jar in the fridge for up to 3 weeks. Warm gently over low heat, stirring, until pourable.
